column1: # scripts/ci-shard-weights.tsv — BD-219 CI shard balance weights (DATA, not logic).
# One row per CI-wired test-runner script: <repo-relative-path>\t<measured_seconds>.
# Consumed by scripts/lib/ci-shard-plan.py (LPT bin-packing). A script absent
# from this file gets the module's DEFAULT_WEIGHT_S (median) — graceful
# degradation (BD-219 §6.5): an un-weighted test never breaks the partition,
# it only mildly unbalances it until the next weight refresh.
# Seed values: the named heavy steps are the MEASURED CI per-step durations
# The remaining wired tests carry a representative measured/estimated weight
# (most validate-pack-Check and tracker-unit tests run ~1–2 s; the ~24 full-
# validator spawns ~1.3 s each — RESEARCH §1.4). Refresh procedure (pack
# maintenance, BD-219 §6.5): `gh run view <id> --json jobs` → update rows.
# Tab-separated. `#` comment lines and blank lines are ignored.
# ── Measured heavy steps (RESEARCH §1.2 — the long poles the shards split) ──
# ── Newly-wired KEEP tests (BD-219 C3 measure-then-bound; offline-confirmed) ──
# ── BD-283 turnkey interactive migration test (offline-confirmed local wall) ──
